title: Agreements
purpose: Find material transfer and data use agreements and see which are in effect today.
summary: Material transfer and data use agreements, and which are in effect today.

tasks.title: Record an agreement
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New agreement]] to record its terms as a draft.
Execute it once it is signed.

tasks.title: Find agreements needing attention
steps: Open [[More filters]], choose Expiring or reporting due within 60 days and select [[Apply]].

good_to_know: The software records agreements as stated. It does not draft or interpret them.
Today is worked out from the recorded dates.
Nothing expires or is enforced automatically, except validity at dispatch.
The 60 days is a display choice, not a policy.

sections.title: What is recorded
paragraphs: An agreement records its kind, parties, dates and the terms as the agreement states them. The software does not draft or interpret agreements. Dispatch needs an agreement with the request's institution that is in effect on the dispatch date and on the day the dispatch is recorded.

items.label: Today
items.description: Computed for today from the recorded dates: Not executed, Valid, Not yet in effect, Expired or Terminated.

items.label: Expires, Reporting due
items.description: As recorded; shown, not enforced except validity at dispatch.

items.label: Search
items.description: AG- number, title, references or institution code.

items.label: More filters: Expiring or reporting due within 60 days
items.description: Executed agreements expiring in the next 60 days, or with a reporting date that has passed or falls in the next 60 days. A display horizon, not a rule; the dashboard queue opens this filter.

items.label: Search, filters, Apply, Clear all
items.description: Search and the filters narrow the rows on the server; Apply runs them and Clear all removes every filter and the search. Active filters show as chips you can remove one by one. An invalid filter shows an error and no rows rather than everything.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Shows or hides columns for you; the first column stays.

items.label: Sorting and paging
items.description: Click a sortable heading to sort; click again to reverse. Rows per page: 25, 50 or 100. The count under the table is the number of rows matching the filters.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads all matching rows across pages as UTF-8 CSV, using the current filters and sort. If more than 10,000 rows match when the export runs, the download stops. Narrow the filters and try again. Text that starts like a spreadsheet formula gets a leading apostrophe. The audit trail records who downloaded the selection, the filters and the number of data rows in the file. With no matches, the CSV contains only the header and the audit count is zero.

sections.title: Actions and access
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.
New agreement (admin and manager) records a draft.
